title: Reason Code 37: outside the account's logon hours
plain_english: The user account in Active Directory has logon-hours restrictions and the request arrived outside them. This is the AD account setting, not the NPS policy's day-and-time constraint (that one is Reason Code 68).

any: According to AD DS user account logon hours

causes.cause: Logon hours are set on the account.
causes.next_check: Active Directory Users and Computers > the user > Account tab > Logon Hours; also check the time zone on the NPS server, which evaluates the restriction.
